text: Code assurance comes only from successful tool results. Code is proved only when a proof succeeded and names at least one function; otherwise it's tested against the model when agreement or conformance succeeded; otherwise it's unchecked. Source discovery or a successful build alone establishes neither. Proved at every size needs a successful nonempty proof and a successful check one size larger, and tested in every state needs successful exhaustive conformance, with positive matching state counts and no failed attempt check. Receipts and the dashboard derive these claims from the evidence, even in older reports with stale labels. Gate outcomes and successful legacy receipts are unchanged (#229, #232).
